dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a pronounced concave curvature, creating a distinct falcate profile from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steeply inclined anterior margin relative to the horizontal axis of the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical pixel height is approximately equal to the pixel width of the fin's base at its point of insertion.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple fine, horizontal linear striations are visible across the lateral surface of the dorsal fin, consistent with superficial epidermal markings.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced bi-tonal pigmentation pattern on the flank below the dorsal fin, showing a contrast transition from dark dorsal grey to a lighter lateral hue.
